title: console-tooling-standup-2026-05-12
content:
Date: 2026-05-12
Attendees: Morgan Lee (owner), Avery Chen, Priya Nair, Diego Ramirez, Samir Patel, + listeners from SRE and DX
Duration: 30m

Agenda:
- Quick sync on UI work (settings + rollout UX)
- Rollout pipeline status and canary metrics
- Analytics/telemetry backlog and data quality issues
- Blockers & action items

Notes:
1) UI / Frontend
- PR #482 (feature flags rollout UI) is out for review (Avery). Waiting on accessibility fixes: keyboard focus states and aria labels. QA found focus trap in modal on small screens.
- Nudge UX: Priya implemented the persist setting for rollout hints; still needs unit tests and small copy update from Content (see Confluence note).
- Design follow-up: Diego to sync with Lina (Design) on spacing changes for the environment selector; proposed change looks good but needs responsive tweak for 320px.
- TODO: Avery to address a11y comments and re-request review by 2026-05-14.

2) Rollouts / Backend
- Canary rollout job (service: rollout-controller) succeeded for customer-x but exhibited elevated 95th pct latency during 10-11:30 PT window. SRE tracing points to increased DB read latency when cache miss spike occurs.
- Temporary mitigation: increased in-memory cache TTL for rollout config to 60s (was 15s). Observed reduction in DB QPS ~28%.
- Long-term: Samir to own a ticket to add exponential backoff + jitter to rollout-controller reads (JIRA: CONSOLE-213). Target: 2026-05-26.
- Metrics: canary success criteria defined in CON-4567; we missed the error budget threshold by 0.4% because one variant returned 500s for a small subset of evals.

3) Analytics / Observability
- Data quality: attribution for UX events missing session_id for ~4% of events between 2026-05-09 and 2026-05-11. Root cause: new SDK release v1.9.0 dropped session propagation header in certain iframe flows.
- Action: Priya rolled back client for affected hosts and created a hotfix branch; patch to SDK accepted in GH PR 498.
- Dashboards: Morgan to add a data completeness panel on the console overview to surface session_id drop and event counts per host. ETA: 2026-05-19.

4) Blockers
- Blocker A: Accessibility issues in PR #482 block release to canary. Blocked owner: Avery. Impact: delays to canary planned for 2026-05-14.
- Blocker B: DB read latency spikes causing canary failures. Blocked owner: Samir & SRE. Mitigation in place; need deeper DB tracing.
- Blocker C: Missing telemetry for rollout reason codes (we currently have a free-text field; we need structured enums). Blocked owner: Priya.

5) Decisions
- Canary threshold loosened by SRE for one additional day (2026-05-13) to allow hotfix cycle for PR #482; teams agreed given mitigation and monitoring.
- Agreed to ship the persist setting behind an internal feature flag (so partners can opt-in) until telemetry enums are implemented.

6) Action items (owners + due dates)
- Avery Chen: Address a11y review comments on PR #482 and re-request review (due 2026-05-14).
- Samir Patel: Create/consolidate JIRA for rollout-controller backoff + DB tracing and schedule SRE deep-dive (create by 2026-05-14; deep-dive by 2026-05-20).
- Priya Nair: Finish telemetry enums spec and open implementation PR (spec by 2026-05-15; PR by 2026-05-22).
- Morgan Lee: Add data completeness/dashboard panel to console overview (due 2026-05-19).
- Diego Ramirez: Sync with Design on environment selector responsive tweaks and post updated screenshots to Confluence (due 2026-05-15).

Parking lot / Notes to self:
- Evaluate whether rollout-config caching can be a local L2 cache per node rather than global TTL bump; potential cost trade-offs.
- Consider adding canary test harness to run synthetic requests to catch DB miss spikes earlier. Samir to prototype.

Links / References:
- Rollout plan: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/CON-4567-console-rollout-plan
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/482
- Hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/498
- JIRA: CONSOLE-213

Next meeting: 2026-05-19 10:00 PT (weekly)

Notes saved by: Morgan Lee

Informal / raw bits (notes to self):
- QA flagged weird flicker when switching envs on slow network; could be CSS transition + reflow. Add perf budget item.
- Samir mentioned we should coordinate with infra on DB connection pool settings for rollout-controller nodes.
